import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class WedssVariant1 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        if (n > 11) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        long[][] points = new long[n][5];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                points[i][j] = sc.nextLong();
            }
        }

        HashSet<Integer> bad = new HashSet<Integer>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            boolean found = false;
            for (int j = 0; j < n && !found; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < n && !found; k++) {
                    if (j != k && !vectorsEqual(points[i], points[j], points[k])
                            && dotPositive(points[i], points[j], points[k])) {
                        bad.add(i + 1);
                        found = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(n - bad.size());
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (!bad.contains(i)) {
                System.out.println(i);
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean vectorsEqual(long[] from, long[] to1, long[] to2) {
        for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
            if (to1[d] - from[d] != to2[d] - from[d]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static boolean dotPositive(long[] from, long[] to1, long[] to2) {
        long sum = 0;
        for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
            sum += (to1[d] - from[d]) * (to2[d] - from[d]);
        }
        return sum > 0;
    }
}
